entities.summary: Rolf Caroli was an East German amateur light-middleweight boxer who won bronze medals at the European championships in 1955, 1957 and 1959. He competed in the 1960 Summer Olympics, but lost in the first bout. His brother was East German boxing champion Georg Caroli.
